headline: Commerce adopts advanced computing export controls
body: The Department of Commerce imposes export licensing requirements on advanced computing chips exported to China. This final rule establishes the stated licensing obligations for the covered products.

headline: Advanced computing export controls
body: The Department of Commerce imposes export licensing requirements on advanced computing chips exported to China. This final rule establishes the stated licensing obligations for the covered products.

headline: Commission adopts platform data remedy
body: The Commission issues an order that prohibits Meta Platforms from using personal data for targeted advertising without consent. The order establishes binding obligations for the named company.

headline: Official semiconductor production interruption
body: The Ministry confirms that semiconductor production in Taiwan is suspended following a verified industrial outage. The announcement concerns economic production and does not describe a military event.
